subject: Part 7 (warmup parity) and Part 60/61 (restart / recovery continuity) evidence verdict
harness: tools/replay_warmup_parity.py (router path A vs warmup path C, per-stream bar-by-bar, end_ts-keyed)
historical data: REAL replayed bars (replay_input 5m CSVs; 15m/1h CSVs as stored) - no synthetic/reconstructed series are fed to warmup

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: restore dispatched per snapshot row in two passes (open then closed), each calling PositionManager.restore which clears first; any snapshot with closed history silently wiped restored open positions (restored_positions=[] on restart).
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: aggregate rows per strategy and call each manager's restore exactly once.
defects_found_and_fixed.verification: restored_positions = 3 expected 3; positions survive warmup and engine.restore().

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: fast-leg end_ts derived via pd.to_datetime(unit='s',utc=True)->tz_convert(IST)->tz_localize(None) then .timestamp(); .timestamp() resolves naive wall time in the process locale, so on non-IST hosts every warmed 5m bar was shifted +5:30 (router first=09:00, warmup first=14:30; offsets measured pre-fix).
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: pandas datetime used only for the calendar-day filter; feed uses raw row timestamp as start_ts and start_ts+fast_minutes*60 as end_ts.
defects_found_and_fixed.verification: post-fix fast streams: A first=09:00 last=23:25 == C first=09:00 last=23:25.

warmup_parity.verdict: VERIFIED at the 5m fast layer; HTF layers bounded by data provenance (see limits)

5m.note: all 174 bars of both GOLDM(569003) and SILVERM(483080) warmup-vs-router line = bit exact.

15m.status: end_ts grids aligned 09:15..23:15; line deltas only from early-anchor/window composition (gold maxdiff 17.22 on 4th decimal magnitude scale, silver 250.74 on first partial) — steady-state values converge to machine accuracy before the checkpoint.

1h.status: 15 bars aligned 09:00..23:00; bounded steady delta maxdiff 28.84 (SILVERM) / 28.47 (GOLDM) ~= 0.04% of line, arising from router-side aggregation vs stored-CSV bar composition (seen earlier: replay_input 1h rows carry a 2026-09-02 09:30 anchor + partial-window row that do not exist in the 5m-derived aggregates).

diverging_fields: mid_value/slow_value on HTF-gated strategies -> line provenance deltas documented above

continuation_comparison.causality: extra B activity is a reversal/stop cascade triggered by small HTF mapped-line deltas (1h band ~28 pts, 15m early-anchor deltas) present from the first post-checkpoint HTF-gated bar; the 5m fast layer and checkpoint topology are bit/structurally exact.

final_ratings.part_7_warmup_parity: VERIFIED (5m fast layer bit-exact for both instruments); 15m/1h warmup line reconstruction bounded by ~0.04% provenance delta - NOT VERIFIED as bit-equal because broker-native 15m/60m historical bars are not available offline (replay_input 1h itself carries a synthetic-anchor row).
final_ratings.part_60_restart_state_reconstruction: VERIFIED (positions/orders/trade topology and fast-layer indicator state reconstructed identically; two real restore/warmup defects found and fixed).
final_ratings.part_61_restart_decision_continuity: VERIFIED-with-proviso: full-trade-identical continuation holds for the fast-layer-driven decision machinery; bit-identical continuation across all four strategies is not certifiable offline because running-configuration HTF (1h) history differs from the warmup-visible stored history by bounded provenance deltas that flip reversal/stop cascades.
